contract.purpose: Explain why a Mac feels slow and provide one safe, evidence-backed next step.
contract.canonicalPurpose: PerformanceDaddy helps Mac users investigate slowdowns, understand active workloads, find regressions against known-good evidence and optimize repeatable workflows through bounded native measurement and comparable verification.
contract.driftNote: Calm Triage is the approved incident-investigation surface; Live, regression and workflow-lab surfaces require a future design selection.
contract.audience: Mac users, especially developers, who do not want to interpret raw system metrics.
contract.job: Turn a slowdown captured now into a trustworthy cause and safe next action.
contract.thesis: A calm plain-language verdict should lead; technical evidence should earn confidence through progressive disclosure.
contract.system: Cool fog canvas, deep ink type, coral active-load role, mint verified-healthy role, blue deliberate-action role, large verdict typography and three stacked narrative bands.
contract.signature: NOW, WHY and NEXT convert symptom to cause to action in one scan.
contract.risk: The deliberately simple surface may initially under-serve experts, so evidence expands without displacing the verdict.

detector.note: The web-oriented detector does not support Swift; native source and live AX review were used instead.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner selected direction C, Calm Triage, on 2026-09-19.
